_comment: Ratchet expectations for the opt-in corpus sweep (plan invariants I1/I2).
These are AGGREGATE budgets only - no file names, no structural data - so
they are safe to commit while the corpus itself stays private.
Counts may only ever go DOWN. Lower them as the idempotence-fixes task
lands; never raise them to make a failing run pass.

known_failure_categories.line_wrap_instability: wrap_line() emits a different continuation on the second pass (trailing space before '='). Dominant cause.
known_failure_categories.afix_code_drift: AFIX 13 is re-emitted as AFIX 43 - a semantic change, not formatting.
known_failure_categories.rem_trailing_whitespace: REM continuation lines gain/lose a trailing space before '='.
known_failure_categories.sfac_spacing: SFAC element columns re-pad on reparse, e.g. 'Mg  O Si' -> 'Mg  O  Si'.
known_failure_categories.sadi_trailing_space: Long SADI lines gain a trailing space before the continuation marker.
known_failure_categories.sfac_full_form_keyerror: SFAC given in the full exponential-series form raises KeyError('a1').
